title: CORNER BLOCK: CASH LABEL, WIDER GAP
why: The picture critic found the unlabelled money figure read as part of the xp pair and the columns were tight. A short cash label and 20 between columns fix it.
now: The corner block names the money figure cash and spaces its two columns wider.

edits.replacement: cw=(g.bw-36)/2, cx=g.x+8+(i&1)*(cw+20);   // v33.xx (cw-cornercompact2): 20 between the two columns, so a figure never touches the next label
trRow(i++,'cash','$'+TRV.c); /* v33.xx (cw-cornercompact2): the critic found the money figure with no label read as part of the xp pair; a short word names it */
